en.title: ASEAN Taxonomy for Sustainable Finance explained
en.standfirst: How the ASEAN Taxonomy for Sustainable Finance classifies green and transition activities, and how to prepare a project for regional green investment.
en.metaDescription: Understand the ASEAN Taxonomy for Sustainable Finance: Foundation Framework, Plus Standard, the Amber transition tier and how to prepare a financing proposal.
en.body:
Businesses assessing clean-energy and infrastructure projects in ASEAN need to consider both sustainability classification and commercial financing requirements.

The **ASEAN Taxonomy for Sustainable Finance** supports assessment of environmental and transition activities. Financing is a separate matter, decided by banks, development finance institutions and investors against their own criteria.

For businesses researching **green loans**, **ESG reporting in Southeast Asia** and the **transition finance Amber tier**, classification and funding approval should be assessed separately.

## The ASEAN Taxonomy explained

The taxonomy provides a framework for assessing sustainable and transitional economic activities.

Its structure distinguishes the **Foundation Framework** from the **Plus Standard**. The Foundation Framework uses a principles-based assessment, while the Plus Standard uses technical screening criteria. They should not be presented as interchangeable reporting tiers. [ASEAN: Taxonomy framework explanation](https://asean.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/ASEAN-Taxonomy-FAQ-20Dec2024.pdf)

The ASEAN Taxonomy Board released Version 4 in 2026, extending the framework's coverage and guidance. Check the current version and applicable national requirements when assessing a project. [ASEAN Taxonomy Board: Version 4 announcement](https://afcwp.asean.org/asean-taxonomy-board-releases-complete-version-of-asean-taxonomy-for-sustainable-finance/)

Taxonomy alignment should not be described as a universal legal prerequisite for every financing product.

## The importance of Amber transition finance

The taxonomy recognises a distinction between green activities and activities meeting relevant transition criteria.

Amber classifications provide a way to assess transition rather than treating every activity as either already green or wholly outside the framework. However, an Amber label does not automatically secure funding.

Apply the relevant criteria to the particular activity and document the proposed transition. Environmental assessment should also address the applicable social considerations rather than assuming emissions improvements alone establish alignment.

Green and Amber classifications should be read in the context of the full taxonomy rather than as an exhaustive two-tier summary.

## Securing the capital

Prepare the sustainability assessment alongside the commercial financing proposal.

Practical preparation includes:

1. Mapping the activity against applicable taxonomy criteria.
2. Preparing supporting ESG disclosures and financial modelling.
3. Discussing potential financing with prospective lenders or investors at an early stage.

Confirm what evidence the prospective financier requires. Taxonomy classification, domestic regulatory compliance and credit approval answer different questions.

The prospective financier conducts its own financing assessment, while the ASEAN Taxonomy Board governs the taxonomy framework. A clear proposal should explain both the project's transition contribution and its commercial viability.

zh.title: 東協永續金融分類標準解析
zh.standfirst: 東協永續金融分類標準如何界定綠色與轉型活動，以及如何為專案準備區域綠色投資。
zh.metaDescription: 了解東協永續金融分類標準：基礎框架、進階標準、琥珀色轉型層級，以及如何準備融資提案。
zh.body:
評估東協清潔能源與基礎設施專案的企業，需要同時考慮永續性分類與商業融資的要求。

**東協永續金融分類標準（ASEAN Taxonomy for Sustainable Finance）**可協助評估環境活動與轉型活動。融資則是另一個獨立的問題，由銀行、開發金融機構及投資人依其自身標準決定。

對於研究**綠色貸款**、**東南亞 ESG 報告**要求及**琥珀色（Amber）轉型金融層級**的企業而言，分類結果與融資核准應分開評估。

## 東協分類標準解析

此分類標準提供了評估永續及轉型經濟活動的框架。

其架構區分為**基礎框架（Foundation Framework）**與**進階標準（Plus Standard）**。基礎框架採用原則導向的評估方式，進階標準則採用技術篩選準則。兩者不應被視為可互換的報告層級。[東協：分類標準框架說明](https://asean.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/ASEAN-Taxonomy-FAQ-20Dec2024.pdf)

東協分類標準委員會（ASEAN Taxonomy Board）於 2026 年發布第 4 版，擴大了框架的涵蓋範圍與指引。評估專案時，請確認現行版本及適用的各國要求。[東協分類標準委員會：第 4 版發布公告](https://afcwp.asean.org/asean-taxonomy-board-releases-complete-version-of-asean-taxonomy-for-sustainable-finance/)

不應將符合分類標準描述為所有融資產品的普遍法律前提。

## 琥珀色轉型金融的重要性

此分類標準區分綠色活動與符合相關轉型準則的活動。

琥珀色分類提供了評估轉型的途徑，而不是將每項活動都歸為「已經是綠色」或「完全在框架之外」。不過，取得琥珀色標籤並不會自動保證取得融資。

請將相關準則套用於具體活動，並記錄擬定的轉型路徑。環境評估也應處理適用的社會考量，而不是假設僅憑減排改善即可符合標準。

綠色與琥珀色分類應在完整分類標準的脈絡下解讀，而非視為窮盡的兩層級摘要。

## 取得資金

在準備商業融資提案的同時，一併準備永續性評估。

實務上的準備工作包括：

1. 將活動對照適用的分類標準準則進行比對。
2. 準備支持性的 ESG 揭露資料與財務模型。
3. 及早與潛在的貸款機構或投資人討論融資可能性。

確認潛在融資方需要哪些證明文件。分類標準的歸類、國內法規遵循與信用核准，各自回答不同的問題。

潛在融資方會進行自己的融資評估，而東協分類標準委員會則負責管理分類標準框架。一份清楚的提案應同時說明專案對轉型的貢獻及其商業可行性。
